status: RUNNABLE (02 RTE V2): every step runs.
description: The obstacles of the auto-router are the clash bodies of the V1 run model, insulation included. A hot DN150 header (180 degC, spec insulation H = 60 mm) runs along x at y 0, z 3000. A DN100 line must cross it from (5000, -3000, 3000) to (5000, 3000, 3000): it jogs over or under the header (equal cost; the search order takes under). The header body is the insulation envelope, half section 84.15 + 60 = 144.15 mm; the new pipe adds 57.15 + clearance 150, so its centreline must clear z 3000 by 351.3 mm: on the 50 mm lattice that is 400 (350 falls 1.3 mm short). Without the insulation 291.3 mm would do (350, 6700 mm).

harness.note: the test harness (and the CLI --param-file) inlines the fixtures before the run: catalog_stub_cs150.json = the input dimensions of these plans (catalogue rte-validation-stub), spec_cs150.json = spec CS150 in the 01 PSC llull-pipe-spec format

expected.source: 6000 along y + 2 x 400 jog (351.3 mm rounded up on the 50 mm lattice)
up, across, down needs 4 bends; going round the header end is 5000 mm away
3000 - 400: over and under cost the same; the open set pops the smaller k first (section 5.12 order f, h, i, j, k, axis), so under
